Every rule in full

Amsterdam

The deposit cap 2× basic rent
Dutch law caps the deposit at two months' basic rent, service costs excluded.
Registration BRP · BSN
A landlord cannot forbid registration at the address. Without BRP, a BSN and a bank account get hard. We confirm it in writing before you sign.
The points system WWS
Many Amsterdam homes fall under the points system. An asking rent above the legal maximum is leverage. We run the check.
Contract type since 2024
Since 2024 the default contract is indefinite. Fixed-term offers are the exception, with conditions. We check which one you are handed.

Barcelona

Who pays the agent LAU art. 20
The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs. You hire us, in writing, for an optional service.
The deposit fianza · INCASÒL
Habitual lease: one month. The landlord lodges it with INCASÒL; we ask for the receipt.
Registration padrón · NIE
Your lease needs the full address, cadastral reference and both signatures, or the town hall refuses it.

Also on the Barcelona page: The rent cap and Contract type.

London

Also on the London page: Who may charge you, Rent in advance, One asking rent, The deposit, The tenancy and Right to Rent.

Madrid

Who pays the agent LAU art. 20
The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs; their agent charging you is a red flag. Hiring us is optional, in writing.
The deposit fianza
Habitual lease: one month. Other lease types differ, and agents ask for more. We check.
The rent no regional cap
No regional cap in Madrid: the asking price is the market. We say if it is out of line and read the update clause.
Registration padrón · NIE
Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you sign.

Also on the Madrid page: Contract type.

Milan

Which contract 4+4 · 3+2 · transitorio
A 4+4 at a rent set freely. A 3+2 within the bands of Milan's local agreement. A transitorio, up to 18 months, only with a documented reason. We check which one you are handed.
The deposit art. 11 L. 392/1978
At most three months' rent, by law, and the landlord owes you legal interest on it every year. We check the clause before you sign.
What the rent covers spese condominiali
Condominium charges, heating, utilities: what is in the rent, and what is not. We ask for the answer in writing before you sign.
Residence Anagrafe · codice fiscale
Codice fiscale first. Then report your Milan address to the Anagrafe within 20 days of moving in, with the lease in hand. We check the lease is in your name, at that address.

Also on the Milan page: Who pays the agency and Registration.

Before you ask

Questions about BOOM Desks.

01 What is a BOOM desk?

A tenant-side rental desk: an agent you hire to find and secure a home in a European city, paid by you only, never by the landlord or their agent. Each desk has its own page, its local checks and three flat fares.

02 Which cities have a BOOM desk?

Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Madrid and Milan. Berlin and Paris are not open: we would open them only with a locally licensed partner, and nothing is sold there today. In Rome, BOOM is the agency itself, with its own homes to rent.

03 Do the fares change from city to city?

No. Full Search €500, Application Pack €199 and Attended Viewing €149 per viewing, VAT included, at every desk; the London desk charges the same figures in pounds. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

04 Who answers, and when?

Valentino Egidi, on WhatsApp from each desk's page, or by email: Monday to Friday, 09:00–19:00 Rome time; the London desk 08:00–18:00 London time. A reply comes the same working day.

05 Is BOOM Milan a real estate agency?

Yes. BOOM Milan is a desk of Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome (REA RM-1710623), under the same Italian law as BOOM Rome. It works for the tenant only: you hire and pay it, never the landlord.

06 Can I pay on this page?

No. Each desk takes its fares on its own page, with the 14-day right of withdrawal and the model form. Every desk starts with a free call, and nothing is charged for it.
